race.name: Variant Human
race.description:
Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. Whatever drives them, humans are the innovators, the achievers, and the pioneers of the worlds.

Racial Traits
+1 to All Ability Scores, Extra Language

If your campaign uses the optional feat rules from the Player’s Handbook, your Dungeon Master might allow these variant traits, all of which replace the human’s Ability Score Increase trait.

background.name: Farmer
background.description:
Ability Scores: Strength, Constitution, Wisdom
Feat: Tough
Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling and Nature
Tool Proficiency: Carpenter's Tools
Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Sickle, Carpenter's Tools, Healer's Kit, Iron Pot, Shovel, Traveler's Clothes, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

You grew up close to the land. Years tending animals and cultivating the earth rewarded you with patience and good health. You have a keen appreciation for nature’s bounty alongside a healthy respect for nature’s wrath.

equipment.name: Chain Mail
equipment.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.

equipment.name: Javelin
equipment.description:
Proficiency with a Javelin allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

This weapon has the following mastery property. To use this property, you must have a feature that lets you use it.

Slow. If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn’t exceed 10 feet.

properties.name: Thrown
properties.description: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

properties.name: Slow
properties.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

equipment.name: Sickle
equipment.description:
Proficiency with a Sickle allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

This weapon has the following mastery property. To use this property, you must have a feature that lets you use it.

Nick. When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

properties.name: Light
properties.description: When you take the [action]Attack[/action] action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don’t add your ability modifier to the extra attack’s damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a [items]Shortsword[/items] in one hand and a [items]Dagger[/items] in the other using the [action]Attack[/action] action and a Bonus Action, but you don’t add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

properties.name: Nick
properties.description: When you make the extra attack of the [wprop]Light[/wprop] property, you can make it as part of the [action]Attack[/action] action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

equipment.name: Flail
equipment.description:
Proficiency with a Flail allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

This weapon has the following mastery property. To use this property, you must have a feature that lets you use it.

Sap. If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

properties.name: Sap
properties.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

equipment.name: Greatsword
equipment.description:
Proficiency with a Greatsword allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

This weapon has the following mastery property. To use this property, you must have a feature that lets you use it.

Graze. If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

properties.name: Heavy
properties.description: You have [rules]Disadvantage[/rules] on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it’s a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn’t at least 13 or if it’s a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn’t at least 13.

properties.name: Two-Handed
properties.description: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

properties.name: Graze
properties.description: If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

equipment.name: Backpack
equipment.description: A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.

equipment.name: Iron Pot
equipment.description: An Iron Pot holds up to 1 gallon.

equipment.name: Carpenter's Tools
equipment.description:
Ability: Strength
Utilize: Seal or pry open a door or container (DC 20)
Craft: Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Barrel, Chest, Ladder, Pole, Portable Ram, Torch

If you have proficiency with a tool, add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that’s used with that check, you have Advantage on the check too.

equipment.name: Shovel
equipment.description: Working for 1 hour, you can use a Shovel to dig a hole that is 5 feet on each side in soil or similar material.

equipment.name: Healer's Kit
equipment.description: A Healer’s Kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

equipment.name: Traveler's Clothes
equipment.description: Traveler’s Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

equipment.name: Oil
equipment.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra 5 Fire damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn’t need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

equipment.name: Rations
equipment.description: Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. See “Malnutrition” for the risks of not eating.

equipment.name: Rope
equipment.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. If the creature’s legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

equipment.name: Tinderbox
equipment.description: A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a Candle, Lamp, Lantern, or Torch—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a Bonus Action. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.

equipment.name: Torch
equipment.description: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. When you take the Attack action, you can attack with the Torch, using it as a Simple Melee weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1 Fire damage.

equipment.name: Waterskin
equipment.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don’t drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.

equipment.name: Caltrops
equipment.description: As a Utilize action, you can spread Caltrops from their bag to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Caltrops.

equipment.name: Crowbar
equipment.description: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar’s leverage can be applied.

spells.name: Booming Blade
spells.description:
You brandish the weapon used in the spell’s casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack’s normal effects and then becomes sheathed in booming energy until the start of your next turn. If the target willingly moves 5 feet or more before then, the target takes 1d8 thunder damage, and the spell ends.

This spell’s damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes for moving increases to 2d8. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (2d8 and 3d8) and again at 17th level (3d8 and 4d8).
spells.components_description: a melee weapon worth at least 1 sp

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.description:
You point at one creature you can see within range, and the single chime of a dolorous bell is audible within 10 feet of the target. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 Necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its Hit Points, it instead takes 1d12 Necrotic damage.

Cantrip Upgrade. The damage increases by one die when you reach levels 5 (2d8 or 2d12), 11 (3d8 or 3d12), and 17 (4d8 or 4d12).

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.description:
You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: Bat, Cat, Frog, Hawk, Lizard, Octopus, Owl, Rat, Raven, Spider, Weasel, or another Beast that has a Challenge Rating of 0. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form, though it is a Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice) instead of a Beast. Your familiar acts independently of you, but it obeys your commands.

Telepathic Connection. While your familiar is within 100 feet of you, you can communicate with it telepathically. Additionally, as a Bonus Action, you can see through the familiar’s eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn, gaining the benefits of any special senses it has.

Finally, when you cast a spell with a range of touch, your familiar can deliver the touch. Your familiar must be within 100 feet of you, and it must take a Reaction to deliver the touch when you cast the spell.

Combat. The familiar is an ally to you and your allies. It rolls its own Initiative and acts on its own turn. A familiar can’t attack, but it can take other actions as normal.

Disappearance of the Familiar. When the familiar drops to 0 Hit Points, it disappears. It reappears after you cast this spell again. As a Magic action, you can temporarily dismiss the familiar to a pocket dimension. Alternatively, you can dismiss it forever. As a Magic action while it is temporarily dismissed, you can cause it to reappear in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. Whenever the familiar drops to 0 Hit Points or disappears into the pocket dimension, it leaves behind in its space anything it was wearing or carrying.

One Familiar Only. You can’t have more than one familiar at a time. If you cast this spell while you have a familiar, you instead cause it to adopt a new eligible form.
spells.components_description: burning incense worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description:
Each creature of your choice in a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it must repeat the save. If the target fails the second save, the target has the Unconscious condition for the duration. The spell ends on a target if it takes damage or someone within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it out of the spell’s effect.

Creatures that don’t sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on saves against this spell.
spells.components_description: a pinch of sand or rose petals

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description:
You unleash a wave of thunderous energy. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

In addition, unsecured objects that are entirely within the Cube are pushed 10 feet away from you, and a thunderous boom is audible within 300 feet.

Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice. Humans typically learn the languages of other peoples they deal with, including obscure dialects. They are fond of sprinkling their speech with words borrowed from other tongues: Orc curses, Elvish musical expressions, Dwarvish military phrases, and so on.

features.name: Skills
features.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

features.name: Feat
features.description: You gain one feat of your choice.

features.name: Great Weapon Master
features.description:
You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits:

  • On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.
  • Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

features.name: Farmer Ability Score Improvements
features.description: The Farmer Background allows you to choose between Strength, Constitution, and Wisdom. Increase one of these scores by 2 and another one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description:
Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of those weapon choices.

When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the Fighter Features table.

features.name: Great Weapon Fighting
features.description:
Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)

When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.

features.name: Tough
features.description:
Origin Feat

Your Hit Point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your Hit Point maximum increases by an additional 2 Hit Points.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
You have learned to cast spells.

Cantrips. You know two cantrips of your choice from the Wizard spell list. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another cantrip of your choice from the Wizard spell list.

When you reach Fighter level 10, you learn another Wizard cantrip of your choice.

Spell Slots. The Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows how many spell slots you have to cast your level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

Whenever that number increases, choose additional spells from the Wizard spell list until the number of spells on your list matches the number on the table. The chosen spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots. For example, if you’re a level 7 Fighter, your list of prepared spells can include five Wizard spells of levels 1 and 2 in any combination.

Changing Your Prepared Spells. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace one spell on your list with another Wizard spell for which you have spell slots.

Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your Wizard spells.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use an Arcane Focus as a Spellcasting Focus for your Wizard spells.

features.name: War Bond
features.description:
You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a Short Rest. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon and forge the bond. The bond fails if another Fighter is bonded to the weapon or if the weapon is a magic item to which someone else is attuned.

Once you have bonded a weapon to yourself, you can’t be disarmed of that weapon unless you have the Incapacitated condition. If it is on the same plane of existence, you can summon that weapon as a Bonus Action, causing it to teleport instantly to your hand.

You can have up to two bonded weapons, but you can summon only one at a time with a Bonus Action. If you attempt to bond with a third weapon, you must break the bond with one of the other two.

features.name: Core Fighter Traits
features.description:
As a Level 1 Character:

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Fighter Traits table.
  • Gain the Fighter’s level 1 features.
Core Fighter Traits
Primary Ability Strength or Dexterity
Hit Point Die D10 per Fighter level
Saving Throw Proficiencies Strength and Constitution
Skill Proficiencies Choose 2: Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, Perception, or Survival
Weapon Proficiencies Simple and Martial weapons
Armor Training Light, Medium, and Heavy armor and Shields
Starting Equipment Choose A, B, or C: (A) Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 4 GP; (B) Studded Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 11 GP; or (C) 155 GP

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description:
You have honed your martial prowess and gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you can replace the feat you chose with a different Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description:
You have a limited well of physical and mental stamina that you can draw on. As a Bonus Action, you can use it to regain Hit Points equal to 1d10 plus your Fighter level.

You can use this feature twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain more uses of this feature, as shown in the Second Wind column of the Fighter Features table.

When you reach certain Fighter levels, you gain the ability to use the mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon Mastery column of the Fighter Features table.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description:
You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action, except the Magic action.

Once you use this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest. Starting at level 17, you can use it twice before a rest but only once on a turn.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: You have a mind for tactics on and off the battlefield. When you fail an ability check, you can expend a use of your Second Wind to push yourself toward success. Rather than regaining Hit Points, you roll 1d10 and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the check still fails, this use of Second Wind isn’t expended.

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.description: You gain a Fighter subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Fighter levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass’s features that are of your Fighter level or lower.

race.description:
인간은 모든 인류 중에서 가장 적응력이 뛰어나고 야심찬 존재입니다. 무엇이 그들을 움직이든, 인간은 혁신가이자 성취자이며 세상을 개척하는 선구자입니다.

캠페인에서 선택적 특기 규칙을 사용하는 경우 플레이어 핸드북던전 마스터는 인간 종족의 능력치 증가 특성을 대체하는 이러한 변형 특성을 허용할 수 있습니다.

특기: 강인함
기술 숙련: 동물 조련 및 자연
도구 활용 능력: 목공 도구
장비: A 또는 B를 선택하세요. (A) 낫, 목공 도구, 치유사의 도구, 쇠 냄비, 삽, 여행자 옷, 30 GP; 또는 (B) 50 GP

당신은 어려서부터 자연과 가까이 살았습니다. 오랜 세월 동안 가축을 돌보고 땅을 경작하며 인내심과 건강을 길렀습니다. 당신은 자연의 풍요로움에 깊은 감사를 느끼는 동시에 자연의 분노에 대해서도 경외심을 갖고 있습니다.

equipment.name: 체인 메일 (Chain Mail)
equipment.description: 금속 고리가 서로 맞물려 만들어진 체인 메일 마찰을 방지하고 충격을 완화하기 위해 갑옷 아래에 누비 천을 덧대어 착용합니다. 이 갑옷에는 건틀릿도 포함되어 있습니다.

equipment.name: 투창 (Javelin)
equipment.description:
투창 숙련도가 있으면 투창으로 공격할 때 명중 굴림에 숙련 보너스 추가할 수 있습니다.

이 무기는 다음과 같은 숙달 속성 가지고 있습니다. 이 속성을 사용하려면 해당 속성을 사용할 수 있도록 하는 특성이 있어야 합니다.

감속. 이 무기로 생명체 공격하여 피해를 입히면, 다음 턴 시작까지 해당 생명체의 이동 속도를 10피트 감소시킬 수 있습니다. 이 속성을 가진 무기로 생명체 두 번 이상 공격하더라도, 이동 속도 감소량은 10피트를 초과할 수 없습니다.

properties.name: 투척
properties.description: 무기에 ' 투척 속성 있다면, 무기를 던져 원거리 공격 할 수 있으며, 공격의 일부로 무기를 뽑을 수도 있습니다. 무기가 근접 무기 라면, 해당 무기를 사용한 근접 공격에 적용하는 것과 동일한 능력 수정치 공격 및 피해 굴림에 적용합니다.

properties.name: 감속
properties.description: 이 무기로 생명체 공격하여 피해를 입히면, 다음 턴 시작까지 해당 생명체의 이동 속도를 10피트 감소시킬 수 있습니다. 이 속성을 가진 무기로 생명체 두 번 이상 공격하더라도, 이동 속도 감소량은 10피트를 초과하지 않습니다.

equipment.name: 낫 (Sickle)
equipment.description:
낫 사용에 숙련되면 낫으로 공격할 때 명중 굴림에 숙련 보너스 추가할 수 있습니다.

이 무기는 다음과 같은 숙달 속성 가지고 있습니다. 이 속성을 사용하려면 해당 속성을 사용할 수 있도록 하는 특성이 있어야 합니다.

닉. 경량 속성의 추가 공격 할 때, 추가 행동 이 아닌 공격 행동의 일부로 할 수 있습니다. 이 추가 공격 턴당 한 번만 할 수 있습니다.

properties.name: 경량
properties.description: 복용할 때[action]공격[/action] 자신의 턴에 행동으로 경량 무기 사용하여 공격하면, 같은 턴에 추가 행동으로 추가 공격 한 번 더 할 수 있습니다. 추가 공격 다른 경량 무기로 해야 하며, 능력치 수정치가 음수가 아닌 한 추가 공격의 피해량에 능력 수정치 더하지 않습니다. 예를 들어, 다음과 같이 공격할 수 있습니다. [items]소검[/items]한 손에는 그리고[items]단검[/items]다른 하나는 사용하는 것[action]공격[/action] 일반 행동과 추가 행동 사용할 수 있지만, 추가 행동의 피해 굴림 에는 근력 이나 민첩 정치가 음수가 아닌 한 추가하지 않습니다.

properties.name: 닉
properties.description: [wprop]경량[/wprop] 속성의 추가 공격 할 때, 추가 행동 이 아닌 [action]공격[/action] 액션의 일부로 할 수 있습니다. 이 추가 공격 턴당 한 번만 할 수 있습니다.

equipment.name: 플레일 (Flail)
equipment.description:
플레일 숙련은 플레일 사용한 모든 공격의 명중 굴림에 숙련 보너스 더할 수 있게 해줍니다.

이 무기는 다음과 같은 숙달 속성 가지고 있습니다. 이 속성을 사용하려면 해당 속성을 사용할 수 있도록 하는 특성이 있어야 합니다.

약화. 이 무기로 생명체 명중시키면, 그 생명체 당신의 다음 턴이 시작되기 전에 다음 명중 굴림에 불리점 받습니다.

properties.name: 약화
properties.description: 이 무기로 생명체 명중시키면, 그 생명체 다음 턴이 시작되기 전에 다음 명중 굴림에 불리점 받습니다.

equipment.name: 대검 (Greatsword)
equipment.description:
대검 숙련도는 해당 검으로 공격할 때 명중 굴림에 숙련 보너스 추가할 수 있게 해줍니다.

이 무기는 다음과 같은 숙달 속성 가지고 있습니다. 이 속성을 사용하려면 해당 속성을 사용할 수 있도록 하는 특성이 있어야 합니다.

스침. 이 무기로 명중 굴림 했지만 생명체 맞추지 못했을 경우, 명중 굴림에 사용한 능력 수정치 만큼 해당 생명체에게 피해를 줄 수 있습니다. 이 피해는 무기가 입히는 피해 유형과 동일하며, 능력 수정치 높이는 경우에만 피해량을 증가시킬 수 있습니다.

properties.name: 중량
properties.description: 근접 무기 사용할 때 중량 무기 근력 능력치 13 미만이거나, 원거리 무기 사용할 때 민첩 능력치 13 미만이면 중무기로 공격 굴림을 할 때 [rules]불리점[/rules] 받습니다.

properties.name: 양손
properties.description: 양손 무기는 공격할 때 두 손을 모두 사용해야 합니다.

properties.name: 스침
properties.description: 이 무기로 명중 굴림 했지만 생명체 맞추지 못했을 경우, 명중 굴림에 사용한 능력 수정치 만큼 해당 생명체에게 피해를 줄 수 있습니다. 이 피해는 무기가 입히는 피해 유형과 동일하며, 능력 수정치 높이는 경우에만 피해량을 증가시킬 수 있습니다.

equipment.name: 배낭 (Backpack)
equipment.description: 배낭 1세제곱피트 안에 최대 30파운드까지 수납할 수 있습니다. 안장 가방으로도 사용할 수 있습니다.

equipment.name: 쇠 냄비 (Iron Pot)
equipment.description: 쇠 냄비 최대 1갤런까지 담을 수 있습니다.

equipment.name: 목공 도구 (Carpenter's Tools)
equipment.description:
능력: 근력
용도: 문이나 용기를 밀봉하거나 벌려서 열기(DC 20)
제작 도구: 곤봉, 대형 곤봉, 장봉, 통, 상자, 사다리, 장대, 휴대용 램, 횃불

도구 사용에 숙련도가 있다면, 해당 도구를 사용하는 모든 능력 판정에 숙련 보너스 더하십시오. 또한, 해당 판정에 사용되는 기술에 숙련도가 있다면, 판정에 이점 얻습니다.

equipment.name: 삽 (Shovel)
equipment.description: 1시간 동안 삽 사용하여 흙이나 비슷한 재질에 각 변이 5피트인 구멍을 파낼 수 있습니다.

equipment.name: 치유사의 도구 (Healer's Kit)
equipment.description: 치유사의 도구는 10번 사용할 수 있습니다. 활용 행동으로, 지혜 (의학) 판정 없이도 사용 횟수 1회를 소모하여 HP가 0인 의식 불명 생명체 안정시킬 수 있습니다.

equipment.name: 여행자 옷 (Traveler's Clothes)
equipment.description: 여행자 옷 다양한 환경에서의 여행에 적합하도록 내구성이 뛰어난 의류입니다.

equipment.name: 기름 (Oil)
equipment.description:
아래에 자세히 설명된 대로 기름을 생명체, 물체 또는 공간에 뿌리거나 연료로 사용할 수 있습니다.

생명체 또는 물체에 기름 뿌리기. 공격 행동 할 때, 공격 하나를 기름병 던지기로 대체할 수 있습니다. 자신으로부터 20피트 이내에 있는 생명체 이나 물체 하나를 대상으로 지정합니다. 대상은 민첩 내성 굴림 (난이도 8 + 민첩 수정치 + 숙련 보너스)에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 기름에 뒤덮입니다. 기름이 마르기 전(1분 후)에 대상이 화염 피해 입으면, 타는 기름으로 인해 추가로 5의 화염 피해 입습니다.

공간에 기름 뿌리기. 활용 행동 사용하여 기름병에 담긴 기름을 평평한 지면에 부어 자신으로부터 5피트 이내의 5피트 정사각형 영역을 덮을 수 있습니다. 불이 붙으면 기름은 불이 붙은 시점으로부터 2라운드(또는 12초)가 지나 턴이 끝날 때까지 타오르며, 해당 영역에 들어오거나 턴을 종료하는 모든 생명체에게 5의 화염 피해 입힙니다. 생명체 턴당 한 번만 이 피해를 받을 수 있습니다.

연료. 기름은 램프와 등불의 연료로 사용됩니다. 기름병에 불을 붙이면 램프나 등불에서 6시간 동안 탈 수 있습니다. 이 시간은 연속적일 필요는 없으며, (활용 행동으로) 불을 껐다가 다시 켜서 총 6시간 동안 탈 수 있습니다.

equipment.name: 휴대 식량 (Rations)
equipment.description: 휴대 식량 육포, 말린 과일, 건빵, 견과류 등 이동이 간편한 음식으로 구성됩니다. 식사를 하지 않을 경우의 위험성에 대해서는 " 영양실조" 부분을 참조하십시오.

equipment.name: 밧줄 (Rope)
equipment.description:
활용 행동으로, DC 10 민첩 (손재주) 판정에 성공하면 밧줄로 매듭을 묶을 수 있습니다. 이 밧줄 DC 20 근력 (운동) 판정에 성공하면 끊을 수 있습니다.

밧줄 사용하면 생명체가 붙잡힘), 행동 불능) 또는 구속) 상태일 때만 원치 않는 생명체 묶을 수 있습니다. 생명체의 다리가 묶여 있으면, 생명체는 스스로 탈출할 때까지 구속 상태가 됩니다. 밧줄 탈출하려면 생명체 행동으로 민첩 (곡예) 판정(난이도 15)에 성공해야 합니다.

equipment.name: 부싯깃 상자 (Tinderbox)
equipment.description: 부싯깃 상자는 부싯돌, 부싯깃, 그리고 마른 천(보통 가벼운 기름에 적신 것)을 담아 불을 붙이는 데 사용하는 작은 용기입니다. 양초, 램프, 등불, 횃불 등 연료가 노출된 모든 것에 불을 붙이는 데는 추가 행동 필요합니다. 다른 불을 붙이는 데는 1분이 걸립니다.

equipment.name: 횃불 (Torch)
equipment.description: 횃불 1시간 동안 타오르며, 20피트 반경 내에 밝은 빛, 추가로 20피트 반경 내에 희미한 빛 발산합니다. 공격 행동 취할 때, 횃불 단순 근접 무기처럼 사용하여 공격할 수 있습니다. 공격이 명중하면 대상은 화염 피해 1을 입습니다.

equipment.name: 물주머니 (Waterskin)
equipment.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don’t drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.

equipment.name: 마름쇠 (Caltrops)
equipment.description: 활용 행동으로, 당신은 가방에서 마름쇠 꺼내 자신으로부터 5피트 이내의 5피트 정사각형 영역에 펼칠 수 있습니다. 해당 턴에 처음으로 이 영역에 들어오는 생명체는 DC 15 민첩 내성 굴림에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 관통 피해 1을 받고 다음 턴 시작까지 이동 속도가 0으로 감소합니다. 마름쇠 회수하는 데는 10분이 걸립니다.

equipment.name: 쇠지렛대 (Crowbar)
equipment.description: 쇠지렛대 사용하면 쇠지렛대의 지렛대 효과를 활용할 수 있는 근력 판정에서 이점 얻습니다.

spells.name: 부밍 블레이드 (Booming Blade)
spells.description:
주문 시전에 사용한 무기를 휘둘러 자신으로부터 5피트 이내의 생명체 하나를 향해 근접 공격 합니다. 공격이 명중하면 대상은 무기 공격의 일반적인 효과를 받은 후 다음 턴 시작까지 폭발하는 에너지로 감싸입니다. 대상이 그 전에 자발적으로 5피트 이상 이동하면, 대상은 1d8 천둥 피해를 입고 주문이 종료됩니다.

This spell’s damage increases when you reach certain levels. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage to the target on a hit, and the damage the target takes for moving increases to 2d8. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level (2d8 and 3d8) and again at 17th level (3d8 and 4d8).

spells.name: 톨 더 데드 (Toll the Dead)
spells.description:
사정거리 내에 있는 생명체 하나를 가리키면, 대상으로부터 10피트 이내에서 애절한 종소리가 울려 퍼집니다. 대상은 지혜 내성 굴림에 성공해야 하며, 실패하면 1d8의 사령 피해 입습니다. 대상이 체력이 부족한 상태라면, 대신 1d12 사령 피해 입습니다.

소마법 강화. 레벨 5(2d8 또는 2d12), 11(3d8 또는 3d12), 17(4d8 또는 4d12)에 도달할 때마다 피해량이 주사위 1개씩 증가합니다.

spells.name: 사역마 찾기 (Find Familiar)
spells.description:
당신은 선택한 동물의 모습을 한 정령, 즉 사역마의 도움을 받게 됩니다. 박쥐, 고양이, 개구리, 매, 도마뱀, 문어, 올빼미, 쥐, 까마귀, 거미, 족제비 중에서 선택할 수 있습니다. 도전 지수 0인 다른 야수사정거리 내의 빈 공간에 나타나는 사역마는 선택한 형태의 능력치를 가지지만, 야수 대신 천상체, 요정, 또는 악마 (선택)입니다. 사역마는 플레이어와 독립적으로 행동하지만, 플레이어의 명령에 복종합니다.

텔레파시 연결. 사역마 100피트 이내에 있을 때, 텔레파시로 소통할 수 있습니다. 또한, 추가 행동으로 다음 턴 시작까지 사역마의 눈으로 보고 사역마가 듣는 것을 들을 수 있으며, 사역마가 가진 특수 감각의 이점을 누릴 수 있습니다.

마지막으로, 접촉 범위가 있는 주문을 시전할 때, 사역마가 접촉을 전달할 수 있습니다. 사역마는 시전자로부터 100피트 이내에 있어야 하며, 주문 시전 시 반응 행동을 해야 접촉을 전달할 수 있습니다.

전투. 사역마는 당신과 당신의 아군에게 아군입니다. 사역마는 스스로 행동 순서를 정하고 자신의 턴에 행동합니다. 사역마는 공격할 수 없지만, 다른 행동은 정상적으로 할 수 있습니다.

사역마의 소멸. 사역마의 생명력이 0이 되면, 사역마는 사라집니다. 이 주문을 다시 시전하면 사역마는 다시 나타납니다. 마법 행동으로 사역마를 일시적으로 차원 주머니로 보낼 수 있습니다. 또는 영구적으로 보낼 수도 있습니다. 사역마가 일시적으로 사라진 동안 마법 행동으로 자신으로부터 30피트 이내의 빈 공간에 사역마를 다시 나타나게 할 수 있습니다. 사역마 생명력이 0이 되거나 차원 주머니로 사라질 때마다, 사역마가 착용하거나 소지하고 있던 모든 것은 그 자리에 남습니다.

한 번에 한 마리의 사역마 사역마는 하나만. 거느릴 수 있습니다. 사역마를 거느린 상태에서 이 주문을 시전하면, 사역마가 새로운 적합한 형태로 변신하게 됩니다.

spells.name: 수면 (Sleep)
spells.description:
사정거리 내 한 지점을 중심으로 반경 5피트 구체 내에 있는 생명체 누구든지 지혜 내성 굴림에 성공해야 합니다. 실패할 경우 다음 턴 종료까지 행동 불능 상태가 되며, 이후 다시 내성 굴림을 해야 합니다. 두 번째 내성 굴림에도 실패하면 대상은 지속 시간 동안 의식 불명 상태가 됩니다. 대상이 피해를 입거나, 대상으로부터 5피트 이내에 있는 누군가가 행동을 취해 대상을 흔들어 주문의 효과를 해제하면 주문은 종료됩니다.

엘프처럼 잠을 자지 않는 생물이나 피로 상태에 면역인 생물은 이 주문에 대한 내성 굴림에 자동으로 성공합니다.
spells.components_description: 모래 한 꼬집이나 장미 꽃잎 한 톨

spells.name: 천둥파동 (Thunderwave)
spells.description:
You unleash a wave of thunderous energy. Each creature in a 15-foot Cube originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 Thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

In addition, unsecured objects that are entirely within the Cube are pushed 10 feet away from you, and a thunderous boom is audible within 300 feet.

상위 레벨 주문 슬롯 사용. 주문 슬롯 레벨 1을 초과할 때마다 피해량이 1d8씩 증가합니다.

features.name: 언어 (Languages)
features.description: 공용어와 원하는 언어 하나를 말하고 읽고 쓸 수 있습니다. 인간은 일반적으로 교류하는 다른 민족의 언어, 심지어 잘 알려지지 않은 방언까지도 배웁니다. 또한 오크의 욕설, 엘프의 음악 표현, 드워프의 군사 용어 등 다른 언어에서 빌려온 단어를 자신들의 말에 섞어 쓰는 것을 좋아합니다.

features.name: 기술 (Skills)
features.description: 당신은 자신이 선택한 한 가지 기술에 숙련도를 쌓게 됩니다.

features.name: 특기 (Feat)
features.description: 당신은 원하는 특기 하나를 얻습니다.

features.name: 대형 무기 달인 (Great Weapon Master)
features.description:
당신은 무기의 무게를 이점 활용하여 그 운동량을 이용해 공격의 위력을 높이는 법을 익혔습니다. 그 결과 다음과 같은 이점을 얻게 됩니다.

  • 자신의 차례에 근접 무기로 치명타 입히거나 근접 무기로 생명체 체력을 0으로 만들었을 때, 추가 행동으로 근접 무기 공격 한 번 할 수 있습니다.
  • 숙련된 중량 무기로 근접 공격 하기 전에 명중 굴림에 -5의 페널티를 적용할 수 있습니다. 공격이 명중하면 공격 피해량에 +10을 추가합니다.

features.name: 농부 능력치 향상 (Farmer Ability Score Improvements)
features.description: 농부 배경을 선택하면 근력, 건강, 지혜 중 하나를 선택할 수 있습니다. 이 세 가지 능력치 중 하나를 2만큼 올리고 다른 하나를 1만큼 올리거나, 세 가지 모두 1만큼 올릴 수 있습니다. 단, 어떤 능력치도 20을 초과할 수 없습니다.

features.name: 무기 숙달 (Weapon Mastery)
features.description:
무기 훈련을 통해 여러분은 자신이 선택한 세 가지 종류의 단순 무기 또는 군용 무기의 숙달 속성 활용할 수 있습니다. 긴 휴식 마칠 때마다 무기 훈련을 연습하고 선택한 무기 중 하나를 변경할 수 있습니다.

특정 전사 레벨에 도달하면 전사 특성 표의 무기 숙달 열에 표시된 것처럼 더 많은 종류의 무기 숙달 속성 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

features.name: 대형 무기 전투술 (Great Weapon Fighting)
features.description:
전투 스타일 특기 (필수 조건: 전투 스타일 특성)

양손으로 잡은 근접 무기로 공격할 때, 피해 주사위에서 1이나 2가 나오면 3으로 간주할 수 있습니다. 이 혜택을 받으려면 무기에 ' 양손 ' 또는 ' 다용도 속성 있어야 합니다.

features.name: 강인함 (Tough)
features.description:
기원 특기

이 특기를 얻으면 최대 생명력이 캐릭터 레벨 두 배만큼 증가합니다. 이후 캐릭터 레벨이 오를 때마다 최대 생명력이 추가로 2씩 증가합니다.

features.name: 주문시전 (Spellcasting)
features.description:
당신은 마법을 부리는 법을 배웠습니다.

소마법. 당신은 위저드 주문 목록에서 원하는 캔트립 두 개를 알고 있습니다. 전사 레벨 올릴 때마다 이 캔트립 중 하나를 위저드 주문 목록에서 원하는 다른 소마법으로 교체할 수 있습니다.

전사 레벨 10에 도달하면 원하는 마법사 소마법 하나를 추가로 배웁니다.

주문 슬롯. 엘드리치 나이트 주문시전 표는 1레벨 이상의 주문을 시전하는 데 사용할 수 있는 주문 슬롯 수를 보여줍니다. 긴 휴식 취하면 소모한 모든 슬롯이 회복됩니다.

1레벨 이상 준비된 주문. 이 기능을 사용하여 시전할 수 있는 1레벨 이상 주문 목록을 준비합니다. 시작하려면 위저드 주문 목록에서 1레벨 주문 세 개를 선택하십시오.

전사 레벨이 오를수록 준비된 주문 목록에 있는 주문 수가 증가하며, 이는 엘드리치 나이트 주문시전 준비된 주문 열 ' 열에 표시됩니다. 주문 수가 증가할 때마다 위저드 주문 목록에서 추가 주문을 선택하여 목록에 있는 주문 수가 표에 표시된 숫자와 일치할 때까지 조정하십시오. 선택하는 주문은 반드시 주문 슬롯 있는 레벨의 주문이어야 합니다. 예를 들어, 7레벨 전사라면 준비된 주문 목록에 1레벨과 2레벨 마법사 주문을 어떤 조합으로든 5개까지 포함할 수 있습니다.

준비된 주문 변경하기. 전사 레벨 올릴 때마다 주문 목록에 있는 주문 하나를 주문 슬롯 있는 다른 마법사 주문으로 교체할 수 있습니다.

주문시전 능력치. 지능 마법사 주문의 주문시전 능력치 입니다.

주문시전 매개체. 마법사는 비전 매개체를 주문 주문시전 매개체로 사용할 수 있습니다.

features.name: 전쟁의 유대 (War Bond)
features.description:
당신은 자신과 무기 사이에 마법적인 결속을 맺는 의식 배웁니다. 이 의식 1시간에 걸쳐 진행되며, 짧은 휴식 동안에도 수행할 수 있습니다. 의식 내내 무기는 당신의 손이 닿는 곳에 있어야 하며, 의식이 끝나면 무기를 만져 결속을 맺습니다. 다른 전사가 해당 무기와 결속되어 있거나, 무기가 다른 사람이 조율된 마법 아이템인 경우에는 결속이 끊어집니다.

일단 무기를 자신에게 결속시키면, 행동 불능 상태가 아닌 이상 그 무기를 빼앗길 수 없습니다. 만약 그 무기가 같은 차원에 있다면, 추가 행동으로 그 무기를 소환하여 즉시 손으로 순간 이동시킬 수 있습니다.

최대 두 개의 무기를 결속시킬 수 있지만, 추가 행동으로 한 번에 하나만 소환할 수 있습니다. 세 번째 무기와 결속을 시도하면 기존 두 무기 중 하나와의 결속을 끊어야 합니다.

features.name: 전사 핵심 특성 (Core Fighter Traits)
features.description:
레벨 1 캐릭터로서:

  • 전사 핵심 특성 표에 있는 모든 특성을 획득하세요.
  • 전사의 1레벨 특성을 획득하세요.
전사 핵심 특성
주요 능력치 근력 또는 민첩
생명 주사위 전사 레벨당 d10
내성 굴림 숙련 근력 및 건강
기술 숙련 곡예, 동물 조련, 운동 능력, 역사, 통찰력, 위협, 설득력, 지각력, 생존력 2개 선택:곡예, 동물 조련, 운동, 역사, 통찰, 위협, 설득, 지각 또는 생존
무기 숙련 단순 무기 및 군용 무기
방어구 훈련 경갑, 평갑, 중갑 및 방패

features.name: 전투 스타일 (Fighting Style)
features.description:
당신은 무술 실력을 갈고닦아 원하는 전투 스타일 특기 하나 획득했습니다.

전사 레벨 올릴 때마다, 이전에 선택했던 특기을 다른 전투 스타일 특기으로 교체할 수 있습니다.

features.name: 재기의 바람 (Second Wind)
features.description:
당신은 사용할 수 있는 신체적, 정신적 체력이 제한되어 있습니다. 추가 행동으로, 당신은 1d10에 당신의 전사 레벨 더한 만큼의 HP를 회복할 수 있습니다.

이 기능은 두 번 사용할 수 있습니다. 짧은 휴식 마치면 사용 횟수 1회를 회복하고, 긴 휴식 마치면 사용 횟수를 모두 회복합니다.

전투기 레벨이 특정 수준에 도달하면 전사 특성 표의 ' 재기의 바람' 열에 표시된 것처럼 이 기능의 사용 횟수가 늘어납니다.

features.name: 무기 숙달 (Weapon Mastery)
features.description:
무기 훈련을 통해 여러분은 자신이 선택한 세 가지 종류의 단순 무기 또는 군용 무기의 숙달 속성 활용할 수 있습니다. 긴 휴식 마칠 때마다 무기 훈련을 연습하고 선택한 무기 중 하나를 변경할 수 있습니다.

특정 전사 레벨에 도달하면 전사 특성 표의 무기 숙달 열에 표시된 것처럼 더 많은 종류의 무기 숙달 속성 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

features.name: 행동 쇄도 (Action Surge)
features.description:
잠시 동안 평소의 한계를 뛰어넘을 수 있습니다. 자신의 차례에 마법 행동 제외한 추가 행동을 하나 할 수 있습니다.

이 기능을 한 번 사용하면 짧은 휴식이나 긴 휴식 마칠 때까지 다시 사용할 수 없습니다. 레벨 17부터는 휴식 전에 두 번 사용할 수 있지만, 턴당 한 번만 사용할 수 있습니다.

features.name: 전술적 사고 (Tactical Mind)
features.description: 당신은 전장 안팎에서 전술적인 감각이 뛰어납니다. 능력 판정 실패했을 때, ' 재기의 바람' 사용 횟수 1회를 소모하여 성공에 한 걸음 더 다가갈 수 있습니다. 체력을 회복하는 대신, 1d10을 굴려 나온 숫자를 능력 판정에 더하여 성공 가능성을 높입니다. 만약 판정에 여전히 실패하더라도, ' 재기의 바람' 사용 횟수는 소모되지 않습니다.

features.name: 전사 서브클래스 (Fighter Subclass)
features.description: 원하는 전사 서브클래스 하나를 선택합니다. 하위 직업은 특정 전사 레벨에서 특화된 능력을 부여하는 전문 분야입니다. 이후 게임 내내 선택한 하위 직업의 능력 중 현재 전사 레벨 이하의 능력을 모두 얻게 됩니다.

actions.description:
당신은 사용할 수 있는 신체적, 정신적 체력이 제한되어 있습니다. 추가 행동으로, 당신은 1d10에 당신의 전사 레벨 더한 만큼의 HP를 회복할 수 있습니다.

이 기능은 두 번 사용할 수 있습니다. 짧은 휴식 마치면 사용 횟수 1회를 회복하고, 긴 휴식 마치면 사용 횟수를 모두 회복합니다.

전투기 레벨이 특정 수준에 도달하면 전사 특성 표의 ' 재기의 바람' 열에 표시된 것처럼 이 기능의 사용 횟수가 늘어납니다.

actions.name: 행동 쇄도 (Action Surge)
actions.description:
잠시 동안 평소의 한계를 뛰어넘어 보세요. 당신의 차례에 [action]마법[/action] 행동.

이 기능을 한 번 사용하면 짧은 휴식이나 긴 휴식 마칠 때까지 다시 사용할 수 없습니다. 레벨 17부터는 휴식 전에 두 번 사용할 수 있지만, 턴당 한 번만 사용할 수 있습니다.

actions.name: 전술적 사고 (Tactical Mind)
actions.description: 당신은 전장 안팎에서 전술적인 감각이 뛰어납니다. 능력 판정 실패했을 때, ' 재기의 바람' 사용 횟수 1회를 소모하여 성공에 한 걸음 더 다가갈 수 있습니다. 체력을 회복하는 대신, 1d10을 굴려 나온 숫자를 능력 판정에 더하여 성공 가능성을 높입니다. 만약 판정에 여전히 실패하더라도, ' 재기의 바람' 사용 횟수는 소모되지 않습니다.

actions.name: 전쟁의 유대: 의식적 결속 (War Bond: Ritual Bonding)
actions.description:
당신은 자신과 무기 사이에 마법적인 결속을 맺는 의식 배웁니다. 이 의식 1시간에 걸쳐 진행되며, [rules]짧은 휴식[/rules] 동안에도 수행할 수 있습니다. 의식 내내 무기는 당신의 손이 닿는 곳에 있어야 하며, 의식이 끝나면 무기를 만져 결속을 맺습니다. 다른 전사가 해당 무기와 결속되어 있거나, 무기가 다른 사람이 조율된 마법 아이템인 경우에는 결속이 끊어집니다.

일단 무기를 자신에게 결속시키면, [condition]행동 불능[/condition] 상태가 아닌 이상 그 무기를 빼앗길 수 없습니다. 만약 그 무기가 같은 차원에 있다면, 추가 행동으로 그 무기를 소환하여 즉시 손으로 순간 이동시킬 수 있습니다.

최대 두 개의 무기를 결속시킬 수 있지만, 추가 행동으로 한 번에 하나만 소환할 수 있습니다. 세 번째 무기와 결속을 시도하면 기존 두 무기 중 하나와의 결속을 끊어야 합니다.

actions.name: 전쟁의 유대: 무기 소환 (War Bond: Summon Weapon)
actions.description:
당신은 자신과 무기 사이에 마법적인 결속을 맺는 의식 배웁니다. 이 의식 1시간에 걸쳐 진행되며, [rules]짧은 휴식[/rules] 동안에도 수행할 수 있습니다. 의식 내내 무기는 당신의 손이 닿는 곳에 있어야 하며, 의식이 끝나면 무기를 만져 결속을 맺습니다. 다른 전사가 해당 무기와 결속되어 있거나, 무기가 다른 사람이 조율된 마법 아이템인 경우에는 결속이 끊어집니다.

actions.name: 대형 무기 달인 공격 (Great Weapon Master Attack)
actions.description: 자신의 차례에 근접 무기로 치명타 입히거나 근접 무기로 생명체 HP를 0으로 만들었을 때, 추가 행동으로 근접 무기 공격 한 번 할 수 있습니다.

actions.name: 스침 (대검) (Graze (Greatsword))
actions.description:
무기 훈련을 통해 대검의 숙달 속성 활용할 수 있습니다.

스침. 대검으로 명중 굴림 했지만 생명체 맞추지 못했을 경우, 명중 굴림에 사용한 능력 수정치 만큼 해당 생명체에게 피해를 줄 수 있습니다. 이 피해는 대검 주는 피해 유형과 동일하며, 능력 수정치 높이는 경우에만 피해량을 증가시킬 수 있습니다.

actions.name: 넘어뜨리기 (삼지창) (Topple (Trident))
actions.description:
무기 훈련을 통해 삼지창의 숙달 속성 사용할 수 있습니다.

넘어뜨리기. 삼지창으로 생명체 공격하면, 해당 생명체 건강 내성 굴림 (난이도 8 + 명중 굴림에 사용한 능력 수정치 + 숙련 보너스)을 강제할 수 있습니다. 내성 굴림에 실패하면, 해당 생명체 [condition]넘어짐[/condition] 상태가 됩니다.

actions.name: 감속 (투창) (Slow (Javelin))
actions.description:
무기 훈련을 통해 투창의 숙달 속성 활용할 수 있습니다.

감속. 투창으로 생명체 명중시켜 피해를 입히면, 다음 턴 시작까지 해당 생명체의 이동 속도를 10피트 감소시킬 수 있습니다. 이 속성을 가진 무기로 생명체 두 번 이상 명중시키더라도, 이동 속도 감소량은 10피트를 초과할 수 없습니다.

definition.name: Farmer
definition.description:
Ability Scores: Strength, Constitution, Wisdom
Feat: Tough
Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling and Nature
Tool Proficiency: Carpenter's Tools
Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Sickle, Carpenter's Tools, Healer's Kit, Iron Pot, Shovel, Traveler's Clothes, 30 GP; or (B) 50 GP

You grew up close to the land. Years tending animals and cultivating the earth rewarded you with patience and good health. You have a keen appreciation for nature’s bounty alongside a healthy respect for nature’s wrath.

race.description:
Humans are the most adaptable and ambitious people among the common races. Whatever drives them, humans are the innovators, the achievers, and the pioneers of the worlds.

Racial Traits
+1 to All Ability Scores, Extra Language

If your campaign uses the optional feat rules from the Player’s Handbook, your Dungeon Master might allow these variant traits, all of which replace the human’s Ability Score Increase trait.
race.longDescription: If your campaign uses the optional feat rules from the Player’s Handbook, your Dungeon Master might allow these variant traits, all of which replace the human’s Ability Score Increase trait.

definition.name: Languages
definition.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language of your choice. Humans typically learn the languages of other peoples they deal with, including obscure dialects. They are fond of sprinkling their speech with words borrowed from other tongues: Orc curses, Elvish musical expressions, Dwarvish military phrases, and so on.
definition.snippet: You can speak, read, and write Common and one extra language.

definition.name: Age
definition.description: Humans reach adulthood in their late teens and live less than a century.

definition.name: Size
definition.description: Humans vary widely in height and build, from barely 5 feet to well over 6 feet tall. Regardless of your position in that range, your size is Medium.

definition.name: Speed
definition.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

definition.name: Skills
definition.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.
definition.snippet: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

definition.name: Ability Score Increase
definition.description: Two different ability scores of your choice increase by 1.
definition.snippet: Two different ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

definition.name: Feat
definition.description: You gain one feat of your choice.
definition.snippet: You gain one feat of your choice.

definition.name: Chain Mail
definition.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.

definition.name: Javelin
definition.description:
Proficiency with a Javelin allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

This weapon has the following mastery property. To use this property, you must have a feature that lets you use it.

Slow. If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn’t exceed 10 feet.

properties.name: Thrown
properties.description: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

properties.name: Slow
properties.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

definition.name: Sickle
definition.description:
Proficiency with a Sickle allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

This weapon has the following mastery property. To use this property, you must have a feature that lets you use it.

Nick. When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

properties.name: Light
properties.description: When you take the [action]Attack[/action] action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don’t add your ability modifier to the extra attack’s damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a [items]Shortsword[/items] in one hand and a [items]Dagger[/items] in the other using the [action]Attack[/action] action and a Bonus Action, but you don’t add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

properties.name: Nick
properties.description: When you make the extra attack of the [wprop]Light[/wprop] property, you can make it as part of the [action]Attack[/action] action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

definition.name: Flail
definition.description:
Proficiency with a Flail allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

This weapon has the following mastery property. To use this property, you must have a feature that lets you use it.

Sap. If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

properties.name: Sap
properties.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

definition.name: Greatsword
definition.description:
Proficiency with a Greatsword allows you to add your proficiency bonus to the attack roll for any attack you make with it.

This weapon has the following mastery property. To use this property, you must have a feature that lets you use it.

Graze. If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

properties.name: Heavy
properties.description: You have [rules]Disadvantage[/rules] on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it’s a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn’t at least 13 or if it’s a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn’t at least 13.

properties.name: Two-Handed
properties.description: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

definition.name: Backpack
definition.description: A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.

definition.name: Iron Pot
definition.description: An Iron Pot holds up to 1 gallon.

definition.name: Carpenter's Tools
definition.description:
Ability: Strength
Utilize: Seal or pry open a door or container (DC 20)
Craft: Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff, Barrel, Chest, Ladder, Pole, Portable Ram, Torch

If you have proficiency with a tool, add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that’s used with that check, you have Advantage on the check too.

definition.name: Shovel
definition.description: Working for 1 hour, you can use a Shovel to dig a hole that is 5 feet on each side in soil or similar material.

definition.name: Healer's Kit
definition.description: A Healer’s Kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

definition.name: Traveler's Clothes
definition.description: Traveler’s Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

definition.name: Oil
definition.description:
You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

Dousing a Creature or an Object. When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra 5 Fire damage from burning oil.

Dousing a Space. You can take the Utilize action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

Fuel. Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn’t need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a Utilize action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

definition.name: Rations
definition.description: Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. See “Malnutrition” for the risks of not eating.

definition.name: Rope
definition.description:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. If the creature’s legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action.

definition.name: Tinderbox
definition.description: A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a Candle, Lamp, Lantern, or Torch—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a Bonus Action. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.

definition.name: Torch
definition.description: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. When you take the Attack action, you can attack with the Torch, using it as a Simple Melee weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1 Fire damage.

definition.name: Waterskin
definition.description: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don’t drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.

definition.name: Caltrops
definition.description: As a Utilize action, you can spread Caltrops from their bag to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Caltrops.

definition.name: Crowbar
definition.description: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar’s leverage can be applied.

definition.name: Fighter
definition.description:
A Master of All Arms and Armor

Fighters all share an unparalleled prowess with weapons and armor, and are well acquainted with death, both meting it out and defying it.

Primary Ability: Strength or Dexterity
Hit Point Die: D10
Saves: Strength & Constitution
definition.equipmentDescription:
Choose A, B, or C:
(A) Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 4 GP;
(B) Studded Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 11 GP; or
(C) 155 GP

classFeatures.name: Core Fighter Traits
classFeatures.description:
As a Level 1 Character:

  • Gain all the traits in the Core Fighter Traits table.
  • Gain the Fighter’s level 1 features.
Core Fighter Traits
Primary Ability Strength or Dexterity
Hit Point Die D10 per Fighter level
Saving Throw Proficiencies Strength and Constitution
Skill Proficiencies Choose 2: Acrobatics, Animal Handling, Athletics, History, Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, Perception, or Survival
Weapon Proficiencies Simple and Martial weapons
Armor Training Light, Medium, and Heavy armor and Shields
Starting Equipment Choose A, B, or C: (A) Chain Mail, Greatsword, Flail, 8 Javelins, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 4 GP; (B) Studded Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shortsword, Longbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Dungeoneer’s Pack, and 11 GP; or (C) 155 GP

classFeatures.name: Fighting Style

classFeatures.name: War Bond
classFeatures.description:
You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done during a Short Rest. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon and forge the bond. The bond fails if another Fighter is bonded to the weapon or if the weapon is a magic item to which someone else is attuned.

Once you have bonded a weapon to yourself, you can’t be disarmed of that weapon unless you have the Incapacitated condition. If it is on the same plane of existence, you can summon that weapon as a Bonus Action, causing it to teleport instantly to your hand.

You can have up to two bonded weapons, but you can summon only one at a time with a Bonus Action. If you attempt to bond with a third weapon, you must break the bond with one of the other two.

definition.name: Great Weapon Master
definition.description:
You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits:

  • On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.
  • Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

options.label: Bestial Awakening (Intelligence)
options.description:
The feral world calls to your soul, howling for you to join it. You can give in to the call and transform into a beast, but the touch of silver bites you more deeply than the sharpest fang.

Beast Skin. You always have the Polymorph spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot or spell components but can target only yourself, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for the spell when you cast it without a spell slot.

Searing Silver. Damage from Silvered Weapons ignores any Resistance or Immunity to damage you have. If you take damage from a Silvered Weapon or touch silver with your bare skin (or its equivalent), you can’t regain Hit Points until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

options.label: Call of the Lonely
options.description:
In the depths of your solitude, and when your hope withered on the branch, you were granted a companion you can call on. You never have to be alone again. This companion is Friendly toward you but is deeply unsettling to your allies.

Never Alone. When no other creature can see you, you can use a Bonus Action to call your companion, which appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you. It takes the form of a person or a vague silhouette, and it uses the Doppelganger stat block. It is Friendly toward you and acts as your ally, and it takes its turn on your Initiative in combat. It disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, when you die, or when you use an action to politely dismiss it. When it disappears, it drops anything it was wearing or carrying.

Once you use this Bonus Action, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Precocious Friend. The companion sometimes appears with trinkets, Cursed Curios*, or other items. It might tell you where it got them, or it might not (GM’s choice). If it took the object from someone who misses it or wants it back, that could create difficulties for you.

Unsettling Presence. While your companion is summoned, both it and you exude a frightful air that unnerves your allies. While the companion is summoned, a creature that isn’t Hostile toward you that starts its turn able to see you or the companion must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.

options.label: Collector of Stories (Intelligence)
options.description:
You have an insatiable desire to gather the tales of the world. Sometimes, you inadvertently take the story of meeting another person and keep it to yourself, forever.

Gathered Tales. You always have the Legend Lore spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot or spell components, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it using slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for the spell when you cast it without a spell slot.

Hoarded Stories. When you use this bargain to cast Legend Lore without a spell slot, a Friendly NPC (the GM chooses) forgets ever meeting you. You can meet them again and attempt to rebuild a relationship, but you forever cause an unsettling discomfort in them. That NPC’s attitude toward you can’t ever improve beyond Indifferent, and you have Disadvantage on all Charisma checks against them.

options.description:
The crooked fate that governs Druskenvald has taken a liking to you. You can avoid calamity, but you must pay back your good fortune eventually.

Cheat Fate. When you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. When you do so, if you would take half damage on a successful save, you take no damage instead. Once you use Cheat Fate, you can’t use it again until you pay the price (see below).

Delayed Price. After you use Cheat Fate, your next three saving throws have Disadvantage and can’t have Advantage, and you gain 1 Exhaustion level when you succeed on one of the saves. Once you succeed or fail on the third saving throw, you regain the use of Cheat Fate. The powers that govern the warp and weft of fate don’t take kindly to cheating outside their terms—at the GM’s discretion, saving throws made intentionally or without true consequences simply to pay this price painlessly don’t count.

options.description:
You are a force of charm and allure with which to be reckoned. While others fall over themselves to stumble into your good graces, you might find that you end up needing them more than they need you.

Honeyed Words. As a Magic action, you can speak sweet words to a creature within 60 feet of you. The creature has the Charmed condition for 24 hours, until you use this feature again, or until you or your allies deal any damage to the target or force it to make a saving throw. The Charmed target is your ally and follows your commands as long as they don’t require the target to harm itself. If the target carries out a command it finds odious, it makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, ending the condition on itself on a success. Once the condition ends, the target is immune to this feature for 24 hours.

If the target has Immunity to the Charmed condition, it instead has Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the start of your next turn, and you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your level. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Solitary Weakness. If you start your turn with no allies that you can see or hear within 20 feet of you, you lose any Temporary Hit Points you have from any source, and you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests until the start of your next turn.

options.label: Hand of Death
options.description:
Death has no claim on you. In exchange for staying its cold hand without that hand closing, you become a maw through which death feeds on the world around you.

Adamant Endurance. You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws.

Cling to Life. When you have 0 Hit Points at the start of your turn, or when you die, you can instead choose to regain a number of Hit Points equal to half your maximum. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again. After using it, whenever you regain Hit Points through any means, you gain only half that amount. Once a Humanoid (other than you) dies within 30 feet of you, you regain the use of this feature, and you can regain Hit Points as normal.

Death Knell. Other creatures within 10 feet of you have Disadvantage on Death Saving Throws, and you can’t restore Hit Points to a creature with 0 Hit Points by any means.

options.label: Might of the Old
options.description:
Ancient and primeval power dwells within the oldest forests of Druskenvald. These powers pour their strength into you but can overwhelm you with their unchanging nature.

Ancient Might. Your Strength score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22, and your Dexterity score decreases by 2.

Primeval Strength. As a Bonus Action, you can call upon the might of the ancients to raise your Strength score to 25 for 1 minute, during which time you deal double damage to objects. Once you use this Bonus Action, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

Pyre’s Price. When you activate Primeval Strength, your skin takes on a bark-like texture, during which time you have Vulnerability to Fire damage. Your skin returns to normal when you finish a Long Rest.

options.label: Self-Serving Sacrifice (Intelligence)
options.description:
You can snatch others from the jaws of death, but your own grip lingers too tightly. The feeling of saving others from suffering fills you with resolve, even as it drains the vigor from those you rescue.

Critical Savior. When a creature within 120 feet of you is subjected to a Critical Hit or is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you can use your Reaction to magically switch places with the target. Each of you teleports to the other’s space. Roll a number of d6s equal to half your level. You take Force damage equal to the total rolled, you gain Heroic Inspiration, and your Exhaustion level, if any, is reduced by 1. The target regains Hit Points equal to the total rolled and gains 1 Exhaustion level. You can’t use this feature again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

Draining Presence. When you finish a Short or Long Rest, each creature within 100 feet of you loses one Hit Point Die (before spending Hit Dice in the case of finishing a Short Rest).

Final Sacrifice. You can cast True Resurrection using this bargain requiring no spell slot or spell components. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for the spell when you cast it without a spell slot.

When you cast the spell this way, you die, and nothing can prevent it. Your soul is bound to torment the creature you returned to life, and you can’t be raised from the dead by any means. When the creature takes a Long Rest, it must roll a d20 halfway through the rest’s duration. On a 1, your soul takes the form of a Wraith within 100 feet of the creature and tries to kill it. The wraith vanishes after 8 hours, or when it dies. Once the wraith appears, it can’t appear again for 30 days.

options.description:
The pall of death drapes over you like the Shroud of Druskenvald. This shroud protects you from the depredations of the Undead, but it draws you ever nearer to their cold embrace.

Inured to Undeath. You have Resistance to Necrotic damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws against spells and effects created by Undead.

Unholy Appetite. You must consume one pound of raw flesh (it needn’t be fresh) per day or suffer Malnutrition.

Withering Soul. Features that detect your creature type, such as a Paladin’s Divine Sense or the Detect Evil and Good spell, treat you as Undead if your creature type isn’t Undead already.

options.label: Skin of Coffin Nails
options.description:
Your body becomes as coldly unrelenting as iron nails sealing away the dead. You can shrug off staggering punishment, but the waters of the world no longer embrace you, as if spiting your defiance.

Iron Grit. You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice when you select this Dark Bargain). You can change the damage type to one of the other options when you finish a Short or Long Rest. When you suffer a Critical Hit from the chosen damage type, it becomes a normal hit instead.

Watery Doom. When you are immersed in water or splashed with at least 1 gallon of water (such as from a bucket or being rained on), your skin tightens and grows rusty until you finish a Short or Long Rest. During that time, your Speed and the time you can hold your breath are halved, and your Resistance to the chosen damage type for Iron Grit becomes Vulnerability instead. At the GM’s discretion, other liquids can also trigger this feature.

options.label: Stilled Hungers
options.description:
Food, drink, and maladies of the flesh have lost their hold over you, but these are the very things that keep a soul vital while in the land of the living. Your mind grows ravenous absent those urges—your thoughts crack with gnawing fears, and your dreams wither into crooked nightmares.

Sated Cravings. Forgoing food and drink doesn’t give you Exhaustion levels. You have Resistance to Poison damage, and you have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

Tenuous Psyche. You have Vulnerability to Psychic damage and Disadvantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition. A Calm Emotions spell cast on you suppresses this feature for its duration.

options.label: Unquenchable Fury
options.description:
Anger is a powerful tool. This bargain stokes it into a formidable inferno, but it threatens to consume everything in its path.

Furious Onslaught. As a Bonus Action, or when you take the Attack action on your turn, you can choose to enter a fury. While in this fury, you can make one additional melee attack when you take the Attack action on your turn, and you reduce all damage you take by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The fury ends if you have the Incapacitated condition, if you die, or if you end your turn and there are no creatures within 60 feet of you that you can see or hear. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You also regain the use of this feature when you kill a Humanoid.

Red Haze. While you are in a fury, you must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of your turns. On a successful save, you can choose to end your fury or continue it. On a failed save, you no longer make the saving throw at the start of your turns, and you regard the creature nearest to you that you can see or hear as your enemy (if there are multiple, choose one at random). On each of your turns, you must move as close to the creature as possible and take the Attack action, targeting that creature with melee attacks. If you’re unable to get close enough to the creature to attack it, your turn ends after you’ve used up all your available movement. If the creature dies or can no longer be seen or heard by you, the next nearest creature that you can see or hear becomes your new target.

options.label: Wings of Whispers
options.description:
You have been gifted with secrets that you can call upon in the form of ravens and crows to bear you aloft, but at the risk of revealing your own secrets in turn.

Murderous Flight. As a Bonus Action, you can magically gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed (and you can hover) for 10 minutes. During this time, a mass of shadows takes the shape of a murder of crows and ravens (but they aren’t truly creatures). The birds appear in a 20-foot Emanation originating from you and take flight and whirl around you when you fly. Once you use this feature, you can’t do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest, unless you gain 1 Exhaustion level to use it again early.

Whispered Secrets. The birds that appear when you activate Murderous Flight remain and continue to follow you until you finish a Short or Long Rest. While the birds are present, you have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and the birds whisper your secrets into the minds of other creatures, granting them Advantage on Wisdom (Insight or Perception) checks made against you.

options.label: Bloodsworn (Level 1)
options.description:
Least Milestone Feature

When you achieve the first milestone of this thread, you gain your choice of one of the following benefits.

Cunning. You gain proficiency in your choice of one of the following skills: Deception, Insight, or Intimidation.

Tool of Vengeance. You gain a Common magic item of your choice.

You have been wronged. Now your fate is painted with blood.

Among the Northlanders, no oath is more serious than an oath of vengeance. But when justice cannot be achieved by any other means, a sworn promise to mete out revenge for wrongdoing is the only answer that remains. Those who make such oaths are called Bloodsworn, and their vengeance becomes a tale told by skalds for generations.

As a Bloodsworn, your ultimate goal is revenge upon the one (or ones) who wronged you. Unfortunately, the wrongdoer is beyond your reach, at least for now. This means your plan must be carried out over weeks, months, or even longer. During this time, you’ll no doubt be distracted by other adventures, but your focus demands that you always return to your oath. Bloodsworn must have been wronged or harmed in some way before the gods will accept their blood oath. In most cases, your vengeance will be fatal to your target, but in some situations, other punishments may be more fitting, especially if the wrong you’re avenging doesn’t itself involve a death.

Goals. Work with your GM to create a goal specific to your campaign or use one from the Bloodsworn Goals table. The specific nature of each milestone is dependent on the goal selected and should be agreed upon by both player and GM. Use the suggested milestone benefits described in this section or create new ones based on the rules for creating a thread.

d6 Goal
1 I must kill the one who murdered the one I love.
2 I cannot rest until the usurper who killed my jarl is dead by my hands.
3 A crew of scheming charlatans ruined my family’s business. I vow to punish them in ways the law cannot.
4 The power-mad jarl of our lands has destroyed my community. I have a cunning plan to ensure he is overthrown.
5 My trusted shieldmate betrayed me and left me to die. Now I shall return the favor.
6 I was shamed by the false words of another. I will deliver vengeance tenfold upon my accuser.

When you achieve the first milestone of this thread, you gain the following benefits.

Tides of Fate [1–3, Saving Throws]. Your Speed is reduced by 10 feet. When this occurs, the Speed of another creature of your choice within 30 feet of you increases by 10 feet. These effects last until the end of your next turn.

If you do so, in addition to the normal benefit, the chosen creature does not provoke opportunity attacks and ignores Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn. You bear the brunt of a curse of ill luck, and it’ll get worse before the end.

Northlanders place great faith in the existence of luck. The gods can bestow good fortune upon the faithful, and honorable actions can directly lead to successful endeavors. Likewise, disreputable behavior can bring failure not only to you, but to future generations of your family.

You are one of the unfortunates, chosen by fate or the gods to suffer from ill luck wherever you go. Perhaps you earned this curse through dishonor, oathbreaking, or cowardice. You might bear misfortune as a virtual heirloom, passed down to you by a disreputable ancestor. Other cursemarked are victims of witch’s curses or similar supernatural effects. Whatever the reason, you can’t seem to catch a break.

Strangely, the presence of a Cursemarked can often bring good fortune to those nearby. As long as your friends are willing to put up with your occasional mishaps, the long-term benefit might well be worthwhile. Meanwhile, however, the cursemarked searches for some way to atone for their misdeeds, real or imagined, knowing such a road will be long and will certainly grow worse before the end. Yet when the hand of fortune is turned against you, what else can you do?

1 I will atone for my dishonor by returning a sacred relic to a distant tomb.
2 I can only lift this curse by clearing the name of an ancestor falsely accused of murder.
3 I must prove my courage to the gods by defeating a tribe of marauding giants.
4 I will invoke Freyr’s blessing by forging peace between two warring clans.
5 To end this curse, I shall endure trials of my honor, my valor, and my selflessness.
6 I must convince Wotan himself to intervene and convince the Norns to reshape my fate.

Least Milestone Feature

When you achieve the first milestone of this thread, you gain your choice of one of the following benefits.

Celebrity Explorer. You receive a 30% discount on lodging, supplies, and food from innkeepers, merchants, and proprietors, and it’s common for them to offer you things for free.

Explorer’s Aptitude. Your travels instill you with new knowledge. You gain proficiency in your choice of one of the following skills: Athletics, History, or Perception.

Glory lies just over the horizon. Time to find it.

Explorers occupy an unusual place in Northlands society. Though revered for their courage, they rarely find a comfortable place in a community. Driven by wanderlust, curiosity, boredom, or a simple inability to relate to civilized folks, the Explorer spends most of their time in the wilderness. Some climb mountains, others set sail for lost lands, and still others delve through dark tunnels beneath the earth. For an Explorer, the greatest treasure awaits beyond the next hill.

Whether by choice or by fate, you follow the path less traveled. Perhaps you’re a rugged seafarer or mountaineer seeking discoveries in the wild. Other Explorers are treasure hunters, royal mapmakers, or seekers of truth. You might be an exile, outlaw, or iconoclast, who simply can’t get along with others. Or you might be driven by vision or prophecy to forsake hearth and home for the unknown.

 Work with your GM to create a goal specific to your campaign or use one from the Explorer Goals table. Consult with your Ranger players before allowing a character to take on this thread to make sure no feelings will be hurt.

options.label: Fatebound (Level 1)
options.description:
Least Milestone Feature

When you achieve the first milestone of this thread, you gain your choice of one the following benefits.

Dream Gift. A god, Norn, or other powerful being has given you a gift in a dream. When you awoke, you had a Common magic item of the GM’s choice that may aid you.

Fate’s Blessing. Once per day, while you are Bloodied, you can use your Reaction to get Advantage on a saving throw.

Your fate is written. Make it glorious.

Many warriors loudly boast of their desire for a noble death or an honorable end in battle, to thus earn a seat in the great hall of Valhalla. These boasts are but hopeful wishes since most individuals never see the path of their future. You, however, are not most individuals. You have been blessed, or perhaps cursed, with the knowledge of your end, though this knowledge doesn’t tell you if you succeed or fail in the circumstance surrounding your death. You might know you will die facing a dark warlord, but you don’t know if you will defeat her. Despite this, the Norns have given you a rare opportunity. The knowledge you possess will help you ensure your death is worthy of the sagas.

Some of those who are Fatebound are marked from birth. Others learn of their fate from seers, shamans, or divine visions. Some heroes earn this thread after engaging in activities that move the gods or the Norns to reward them with such a potent end.

Fatebound and Death. Keep in mind that having this thread may mean you can’t die before your fated time, but it doesn’t mean you will reach that point whole and healthy. While your fate is inevitable, luck alone determines your condition when you meet that end. Do you lead a glorious charge across the battlefield? Or are you left guarding the baggage? Has every confrontation leading up to your end prepared you to defeat your ultimate foe? Or has a lifetime of avoidance left you ill-prepared?

If a Fatebound PC is killed before their time, and magical resurrection is not an option, a GM could instead choose for them to be injured in a significant way—such as the loss of a limb or eye. These injuries should not be able to be healed without high-level magic. Alternatively, perhaps they lose one of their powerful magical items instead of their lives, or they might suffer a level of Exhaustion until they reach their next milestone. The GM and player should agree on this complication.

Goals. Work with your GM to create a goal specific to your campaign or use one from the Fatebound Goals table. The specific nature of each milestone is dependent on the goal selected and should be agreed upon by both player and GM. Use the suggested milestone benefits described in this section or create new ones based on the rules for creating a thread.

GM Note: The Fatebound is an unusual thread in that its final milestone specifically describes the manner in which a character might meet with a permanent death, likely as part of the final accomplishment of their goal, and then empowers the PCs’ allies as a reward. Most importantly, this thread should be something the player consciously selects.

d6 Goal
1 I will die only after finding and facing the mightiest dragon in the land.
2 I will be slain by Utgard-Loki while attempting to thwart his plan to slay the gods.
3 To defend my people from invasion, I pledge to pay any price, including my own life.
4 I shall search for and find a fabled lost treasure, but I will die in the process.
5 I will rise to become the North’s greatest reaver, then perish battling the World Serpent.
6 I seek the truth behind the fall of Nordheim, though it will cost my life to learn it.

options.description:
Least Milestone Feature

When you achieve the first milestone of this thread, you gain the following benefits.

Storyteller’s Knack. You learn three languages of your choice.

Performer’s Reward. If you have at least 3 days of downtime between adventures, you can earn GP equal to 10 times your character level by performing your stories in taverns, on the street, or for powerful patrons. Additional downtime events don’t increase this reward.

Your stories don’t just recount events . . . they shape history.

Storytellers are revered in the Northlands. Whether a skald sharing tales around a fire, a lore keeper gathering sagas to pass down the generations, or a grizzled reaver frightening young warriors by recalling harrowing battles, the tradition of collecting stories is respected across nearly all cultures in the region. As a Herald, you are a proud, if temporary, part of this tradition, driven by a need to spread stories during your travels to accomplish a specific end.

Perhaps your stories encourage downtrodden karls to rise up against their cruel jarl, warn a region about an approaching invasion, or convince warriors to join your cause. Part skald, part herald, part envoy, you will use your tales and stories to sway the minds of your audience and help shape the world.

Consult with your Bard players before allowing a character to take on this thread to make sure no feelings will be hurt.

2 By telling the sagas, I will gather support for the greatest raid the North has ever launched.

4 I spread the word of the great crusade to eradicate the darkness beneath Tanserhall. Heed my call!
5 I seek a lost treasure of Hyperborea, and by spreading tales of similar treasures, I hope to find a path to a hidden vault.
6 To rouse the people against their evil king, I shall assemble an array of sorrowful tales of corruption that cannot be ignored.

Neither storm nor night nor bloody fang shall slow your relentless pursuit.

Hunting is as old as the Northlands itself. From volcanic peaks to frigid fens and aurora-bathed glaciers, the tales of hunters are sung alongside those of heroes and gods. While some may hunt for survival or vengeance, you are different. You are a hunter to be feared, as you hunt for the thrill of the chase and the glory of victory.

As a Legend Hunter, you may have been chosen by the Norns, blessed by a god, or forged in trials of blood and grift. No matter how you come to it, your extraordinary search for greater and greater prey sets you apart from those who hunt merely for survival. You do not merely forge trails; you craft sagas. 4 I will go beneath the waves to bring low the mother of all krakens.
5 I will bring back the head of Fenris.
